This name is often given to boys, who are expected to embody these qualities from a young age. In various Islamic communities, the name can also be tied to historical figures of the Prophet Muhammad's companions or soldiers, adding an additional layer of meaning and connection to the Islamic tradition.

It can serve as a call to action for individuals to stand up for what is right, to defend the vulnerable, and to strive for justice in their daily lives. It can also inspire a sense of spiritual fortitude, encouraging individuals to be strong in their faith and to face challenges with determination and resilience. Ultimately, the name "Lraaz" can serve as a source of inspiration and motivation for individuals to live in accordance with these noble qualities and to make positive contributions to their communities and the world at large.
